raw_segments.text: What an excellent father you have, girls," said she, when the door was shut.
I do not know how you will ever make him amends for his kindness, or me either for that matter.
At our time of life it is not so pleasant, I can tell you, to be making new acquaintances
every day, but for your sakes we would do anything.
Lydia, my love, though you are the youngest, I dare say Mr. Bingley will dance with you
